name: livepraise
description: Live Praise — Software de Projeção para Igrejas

scripts.dev: npm run sync:version && npm run build:browser:dev && npm run build:electron && npm run build:operator && node scripts/dev-electron.mjs
scripts.build:server: node scripts/check-node-version.mjs && node scripts/install-yt-dlp.mjs && node scripts/install-ffmpeg.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='dist/server/db/migrations';fs.mkdirSync(p,{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync('server/db/migrations')) fs.copyFileSync('server/db/migrations/'+f,p+'/'+f);" && node scripts/copy-shared-assets.mjs
scripts.build:projector: npm run build:server && tsc -p tsconfig.projector.json && node scripts/strip-browser-sourcemaps.mjs dist/apps/projector && node scripts/copy-browser-app-static.mjs apps/projector
scripts.build:stage-return: tsc -p tsconfig.stage-return.json && node scripts/strip-browser-sourcemaps.mjs dist/apps/stage-return && node scripts/copy-browser-app-static.mjs apps/stage-return
scripts.build:web:live: npm run build:server && tsc -p web/live/tsconfig.json && node scripts/strip-browser-sourcemaps.mjs dist/web/live && node scripts/copy-browser-app-static.mjs web/live
scripts.build:web:external-display: npm run build:server && tsc -p web/external-display/tsconfig.json && node scripts/strip-browser-sourcemaps.mjs dist/web/external-display && node scripts/copy-browser-app-static.mjs web/external-display
scripts.build:web:portal: tsc -p web/portal/tsconfig.json && node scripts/strip-browser-sourcemaps.mjs dist/web/portal && node scripts/copy-browser-app-static.mjs web/portal
scripts.build:web:remote: tsc -p web/remote/tsconfig.json && node scripts/strip-browser-sourcemaps.mjs dist/web/remote && node scripts/copy-browser-app-static.mjs web/remote
scripts.build:web: npm run build:web:live && npm run build:web:external-display && npm run build:web:portal && npm run build:web:remote
scripts.build: npm run sync:version && npm run build:server && npm run build:projector && npm run build:stage-return && npm run build:web && npm run build:electron && npm run build:operator
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:server && npm run build:operator && node dist/server/index.js
scripts.smoke:release: npm run smoke:bootstrap && npm run test:video-pipeline && npm run smoke:textfill && npm run smoke:fase8
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:server && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.projector.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.stage-return.json --noEmit && tsc -p web/live/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p web/external-display/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p web/portal/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p web/remote/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.smoke:version: node scripts/sync-app-version.mjs && npm run build:server && node scripts/smoke-version-sync.mjs
scripts.sync:locales: node scripts/build-en-us-locale.mjs && node scripts/build-pt-pt-locale.mjs && node scripts/build-es-es-locale.mjs
scripts.smoke:locales: npm run sync:locales && npm run build:server && node scripts/smoke-locales-i18n.mjs
scripts.postinstall: node scripts/install-yt-dlp.mjs && node scripts/install-ffmpeg.mjs && node scripts/install-electron.mjs
